say:2:1711054001:1.text: Unfortunately, you don't have the right to refuse guests at the moment.
say:2:1711054001:1.source_cn: 很遗憾，现在的你没有拒绝客人的权利。

say:3:1711054002:1.text: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.
say:3:1711054002:1.source_cn: 是你们啊……梅林阁下，还有伊芙特使。
say:3:1711054002:1.male: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.
say:3:1711054002:1.female: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.

say:4:1711054003:1.text: ... I've already said everything there is to say. Are you here to humiliate a prisoner more?
say:4:1711054003:1.source_cn: ……该说的我都说了，你们还要继续羞辱一个阶下囚吗？

choice_prompt:5:1711054003.text: ... I've already said everything there is to say. Are you here to humiliate a prisoner more?
choice_prompt:5:1711054003.source_cn: ……该说的我都说了，你们还要继续羞辱一个阶下囚吗？

say:6:1711054004:1.text: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.
say:6:1711054004:1.source_cn: 悔改不悔改又能改变什么呢？现在的我只是一个永恒等待的囚徒。
say:6:1711054004:1.male: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.
say:6:1711054004:1.female: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.

say:7:1711054006:1.text: If this were just about the old case with Headmaster Leymar, that's already closed. But unfortunately, your testimony left out the most important part.
say:7:1711054006:1.source_cn: 如果只是为了雷蒙校长的旧案，那已经结案。但很遗憾，格墨...

say:8:1711054007:1.text: Left out? I already admitted I'm the killer. What else do you want?
say:8:1711054007:1.source_cn: 隐瞒？我已经承认我是凶手了，我还隐瞒了什么？

say:9:1711054008:1.text: Or do you want to hear me repent? That's the work of the Temple, not mages.
say:9:1711054008:1.source_cn: 难道你们想听我忏悔？那是圣堂的工作，不是魔法师的。

choice_prompt:10:1711054008.text: Or do you want to hear me repent? That's the work of the Temple, not mages.
choice_prompt:10:1711054008.source_cn: 难道你们想听我忏悔？那是圣堂的工作，不是魔法师的。

say:11:1711054009:1.text: In the previous interrogation, Gervan claimed that the Adamant Syndicate used "dark magic" to heal his legs.
say:11:1711054009:1.source_cn: 在之前的审讯里，格墨文只说是黑金商会用“黑魔法”治好了...

say:12:1711054010:1.text: But he never mentioned that limb regeneration of this magnitude is beyond common dark magic, nor did he mention Cyran's role in this.
say:12:1711054010:1.source_cn: 但他没有提过这种程度的肢体重生，根本不是普通黑魔法能做...

say:13:1711054011:1.text: ... Magister Merlin, you're really overstepping. These are my legs. Does it even matter how they got healed?
say:13:1711054011:1.source_cn: ……梅林阁下，您未免管得太宽了。腿长在我身上，是用什么...
say:13:1711054011:1.male: ... Magister Merlin, you're really overstepping. These are my legs. Does it even matter how they got healed?
say:13:1711054011:1.female: ... Magister Merlin, you're really overstepping. These are my legs. Does it even matter how they got healed?

say:14:1711054012:1.text: Don't forget, I was a victim too. The Adamant Syndicate used me.
say:14:1711054012:1.source_cn: 要知道，我也曾是受害者，是黑金利用了我。
say:14:1711054012:1.male: Don't forget, I was a victim too. The Adamant Syndicate used me.
say:14:1711054012:1.female: Don't forget, I was a victim too. The Adamant Syndicate used me.

say:15:1711054013:1.text: Stop acting, Gervan. We didn't come here to listen to you recite that flimsy testimony again.
say:15:1711054013:1.source_cn: 别演了，格墨文。我们不是来听你背诵那份漏洞百出的供词。

say:16:1711054014:1.text: The dealings between the Syndicate and your family didn't just start recently.
say:16:1711054014:1.source_cn: 黑金商会和你们家族的交易，可不是最近才开始的。

say:17:1711054015:1.text: Three years ago, I confiscated a special smuggled item—a scroll containing a forbidden art.
say:17:1711054015:1.source_cn: 三年前，我曾缴获了一份特殊的走私物品，一个记载着禁术的...

choice_prompt:18:1711054015.text: Three years ago, I confiscated a special smuggled item—a scroll containing a forbidden art.
choice_prompt:18:1711054015.source_cn: 三年前，我曾缴获了一份特殊的走私物品，一个记载着禁术的特殊卷轴。

say:19:1711054016:1.text: ... I don't know what you're talking about.
say:19:1711054016:1.male: ... I don't know what you're talking about.
say:19:1711054016:1.female: ... I don't know what you're talking about.

choice_prompt:20:1711054016.text: ... I don't know what you're talking about.
choice_prompt:20:1711054016.male: ... I don't know what you're talking about.
choice_prompt:20:1711054016.female: ... I don't know what you're talking about.

say:21:1711054017:1.text: It's an extremely dangerous dark magic. The caster pays with their spirit or life force, and the recipient's body or mind suffers permanent damage.
say:21:1711054017:1.source_cn: 那是极其危险的黑魔法。施术者需要付出精神或生命力作为代...

say:22:1711054018:1.text: Most importantly, it has an absolute requirement—the caster and recipient must be blood relatives. Only those who share the same blood can transfer life force like that.
say:22:1711054018:1.source_cn: 施术者与受术者必须是“血亲”。只有流着相同血液的人，才...

say:23:1711054019:1.text: This is the conclusion you and the Queen deduced. Gervan might have used an advanced version of that forbidden art.
say:23:1711054019:1.source_cn: 你紧盯着格墨文，语气步步紧逼。 这是你和王后推演出的结...
say:23:1711054019:1.male: This is the conclusion you and the Queen deduced. Gervan might have used an advanced version of that forbidden art.
say:23:1711054019:1.female: This is the conclusion you and the Queen deduced. Gervan might have used an advanced version of that forbidden art.

say:24:1711054020:1.text: Gervan, you said someone from the Syndicate healed you. So tell me, do you have any relatives in that organization?
say:24:1711054020:1.source_cn: 格墨文，你声称是黑金商会的人治好了你。那么黑金商会里，...

say:25:1711054021:1.text: Or... did you sacrifice a member of House Hastings to regain your legs?
say:25:1711054021:1.source_cn: 还是说……你献祭了某个黑斯廷斯家族的成员，才换回了这双腿？

say:26:1711054022:1.text: Ha... blood relatives? Sacrificing family members? You have quite the imagination.
say:26:1711054022:1.source_cn: 哈……血亲？献祭家族成员？梅林阁下，您的想象力真是丰富。
say:26:1711054022:1.male: Ha... blood relatives? Sacrificing family members? You have quite the imagination.
say:26:1711054022:1.female: Ha... blood relatives? Sacrificing family members? You have quite the imagination.

say:27:1711054023:1.text: The family registry for our house is at the city hall. Feel free to check if any of my relatives have gone missing.
say:27:1711054023:1.source_cn: 黑斯廷斯家族的人口名册就在市政厅，您可以去查查，我有哪...
say:27:1711054023:1.male: The family registry for our house is at the city hall. Feel free to check if any of my relatives have gone missing.
say:27:1711054023:1.female: The family registry for our house is at the city hall. Feel free to check if any of my relatives have gone missing.

say:28:1711054024:1.text: I'll save you the trouble. None at all.
say:28:1711054024:1.source_cn: 我先提前告诉您结果——没有，一个都没有。
say:28:1711054024:1.male: I'll save you the trouble. None at all.
say:28:1711054024:1.female: I'll save you the trouble. None at all.

say:29:1711054025:1.text: Then only two possibilities remain. Either Cyran modified this magic and removed the bloodline requirement, or a secret illegitimate child was sacrificed.
say:29:1711054025:1.source_cn: 既然如此，就只剩下了两种可能——迪尔格雷改良了这个禁术...

say:30:1711054026:1.text: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.
say:30:1711054026:1.source_cn: 秘密私生子？您这推理的能力，不如去写小说。
say:30:1711054026:1.male: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.
say:30:1711054026:1.female: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.

choice_prompt:31:1711054026.text: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.
choice_prompt:31:1711054026.source_cn: 秘密私生子？您这推理的能力，不如去写小说。
choice_prompt:31:1711054026.male: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.
choice_prompt:31:1711054026.female: Ha! Secret illegitimate child? With that kind of logic, maybe you should try writing fiction.

say:33:1711054028:1.text: The so-called "blood relative" restriction exists only because ordinary people have such fragile life forces.
say:33:1711054028:1.source_cn: 所谓的“血亲”限制，不过是因为普通人的生命力太脆弱。
say:33:1711054028:1.male: The so-called "blood relative" restriction exists only because ordinary people have such fragile life forces.
say:33:1711054028:1.female: The so-called "blood relative" restriction exists only because ordinary people have such fragile life forces.

say:34:1711054029:1.text: But Cyran was a genius... In his eyes, barriers like that were meant to be broken.
say:34:1711054029:1.source_cn: 但迪尔格雷是个天才……在他眼里，血缘这种门槛完全可以跨越。
say:34:1711054029:1.male: But Cyran was a genius... In his eyes, barriers like that were meant to be broken.
say:34:1711054029:1.female: But Cyran was a genius... In his eyes, barriers like that were meant to be broken.

say:35:1711054030:1.text: As long as the "resource" was strong enough, the magic abundant enough, and most importantly...
say:35:1711054030:1.source_cn: 只要“资源”足够优质，魔力足够充沛，更重要的是——
say:35:1711054030:1.male: As long as the "resource" was strong enough, the magic abundant enough, and most importantly...
say:35:1711054030:1.female: As long as the "resource" was strong enough, the magic abundant enough, and most importantly...

say:36:1711054031:1.text: As long as the fool is willing.
say:36:1711054031:1.source_cn: 只要那个蠢货是自愿的。
say:36:1711054031:1.male: As long as the fool is willing.
say:36:1711054031:1.female: As long as the fool is willing.

say:37:1711054032:1.text: Willing? You're saying someone volunteered to take the cost?
say:37:1711054032:1.source_cn: 自愿？你想说有人自愿承受代价？

say:38:1711054033:1.text: What, you want to find the victim? And then what, offer them your pity?
say:38:1711054033:1.source_cn: 想要找出那个受害者吗？然后呢？去对他表达你们那廉价的同情心？

say:39:1711054034:1.text: Don't act like you're so noble. In this world, the weak exist to serve the strong.
say:39:1711054034:1.source_cn: 别装好人了……在这个世界上，弱者为了强者牺牲，本就是资...

choice_prompt:40:1711054034.text: Don't act like you're so noble. In this world, the weak exist to serve the strong.
choice_prompt:40:1711054034.source_cn: 别装好人了……在这个世界上，弱者为了强者牺牲，本就是资源的最优配置。

say:41:1711054035:1.text: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?
say:41:1711054035:1.source_cn: 一个拥有充沛魔力，对我毫无防备，又自愿牺牲的人……会是谁呢？
say:41:1711054035:1.male: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?
say:41:1711054035:1.female: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?

choice_prompt:42:1711054035.text: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?
choice_prompt:42:1711054035.source_cn: 一个拥有充沛魔力，对我毫无防备，又自愿牺牲的人……会是谁呢？
choice_prompt:42:1711054035.male: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?
choice_prompt:42:1711054035.female: Someone with abundant mana, who trusted me completely, and was willing to sacrifice themselves. Who do you think?

say:43:1711054036:1.text: Silven trusted you! He even begged for mercy on your behalf!
say:43:1711054036:1.source_cn: 休把你当挚友，甚至还在为你求情！

say:45:1711054038:1.text: Gervan's attitude infuriates Evie, but you notice something off.
say:45:1711054038:1.source_cn: 格墨文的姿态惹恼了伊芙，但你却觉得格墨文那幅挑衅的姿态...
say:45:1711054038:1.male: Gervan's attitude infuriates Evie, but you notice something off.
say:45:1711054038:1.female: Gervan's attitude infuriates Evie, but you notice something off.

say:46:1711054039:1.source_cn: 他承认得太快，又太顺理成章了。

say:47:1711054040:1.text: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.
say:47:1711054040:1.source_cn: 他似乎……迫切地希望你们相信受害者就是休，迫切地希望你...
say:47:1711054040:1.male: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.
say:47:1711054040:1.female: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.

choice_prompt:48:1711054040.text: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.
choice_prompt:48:1711054040.source_cn: 他似乎……迫切地希望你们相信受害者就是休，迫切地希望你们立刻离开这里去确认休的安危。
choice_prompt:48:1711054040.male: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.
choice_prompt:48:1711054040.female: It's almost as if he wants you to believe Silven's the victim, so that you immediately leave to check.

say:49:1711054041:1.text: ... What would I even gain from that?
say:49:1711054041:1.male: ... What would I even gain from that?
say:49:1711054041:1.female: ... What would I even gain from that?

say:50:1711054042:1.text: You look at him and coldly point out that once he and Silven are bound by the forbidden art, that connection leaves traces.
say:50:1711054042:1.source_cn: 你看着眼前这个苍白的男孩，“残忍地”告诉了他，一旦他和...
say:50:1711054042:1.male: You look at him and coldly point out that once he and Silven are bound by the forbidden art, that connection leaves traces.
say:50:1711054042:1.female: You look at him and coldly point out that once he and Silven are bound by the forbidden art, that connection leaves traces.

say:51:1711054043:1.text: And you happen to have a way to trace the source of the mana in his legs. You raise your hand, gathering magic in your palm...
say:51:1711054043:1.source_cn: 而你恰巧有办法追溯他双腿的魔力之源，你抬起手，掌心汇聚...
say:51:1711054043:1.male: And you happen to have a way to trace the source of the mana in his legs. You raise your hand, gathering magic in your palm...
say:51:1711054043:1.female: And you happen to have a way to trace the source of the mana in his legs. You raise your hand, gathering magic in your palm...

choice:48:0:1.text: Are you trying to provoke us?
choice:48:0:1.source_cn: 格墨文，你在试图激怒我们吗？
choice:48:0:1.male: Are you trying to provoke us?
choice:48:0:1.female: Are you trying to provoke us?

choice:31:0:1.text: Then it must have been modified by Cyran.
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 哦，那就只有迪尔格雷改良的选项了
choice:31:0:1.male: Then it must have been modified by Cyran.
choice:31:0:1.female: Then it must have been modified by Cyran.

choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 那正是你腿疾痊愈的原因

choice:18:1:2.text: Your legs were healed by that, right?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 你的腿是禁术治好的吧？
choice:18:1:2.male: Your legs were healed by that, right?
choice:18:1:2.female: Your legs were healed by that, right?

choice:5:0:1.text: You don't seem sorry at all.
choice:5:0:1.male: You don't seem sorry at all.
choice:5:0:1.female: You don't seem sorry at all.

say:54:1711054005:1.text: I don't believe there are any cases left that would involve me again.
say:54:1711054005:1.source_cn: 我不认为还有什么案子会涉及到我。
say:54:1711054005:1.male: I don't believe there are any cases left that would involve me again.
say:54:1711054005:1.female: I don't believe there are any cases left that would involve me again.

choice:5:1:2.text: We're here about a new case.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我们是为了新案子来的
choice:5:1:2.male: We're here about a new case.
choice:5:1:2.female: We're here about a new case.
